Summaries.eng: The Central Woods is home to deer. Nearby the woods a new city emerges- the Platinum City, a place of new technologies, inventions and various new things that are changing the life of human and animals. The Deer Squad of four deer, each carrying supernatural power, guards the residents of the woods and the city. Whenever it comes crisis, it comes the Squad.
Professor Scratch plunges the whole city into darkness in 'Goodnight Central Forest
'Steelzilla', Sir Steel holds a grand parade but his giant Steel blimp grows to enormous size!
All the bees in the Central Forest are captured in 'Save The Bees'
Kai invents a Roboduck to babysit the ducklings, but it goes haywire.
Lola tries her hand at being the park keeper for the day in 'Catfish Capers'
Sir Steel's attempts to clean up with a giant soap machine creates a bubble nightmare.
When Kai joins all the deer's carts together in 'Kai Express'
Sir Steel's super powerful hairdryer creates a giant tornado that sucks up Ian, his ducklings and more.
Sir Steel's Replicator causes havoc in the Central Forest in 'Donut Panic'
Kai overexerts his power on an ice cream machine, the machine turns into a rampaging Ice-Bot.
A raging lake monster appears in 'Deep Blue Boo Boo'
Lola and Sir Steel become stuck together, and have no choice but to work as a team!
A meteor is heading for earth in 'Meteor Mayhem'
A dance competition in the Central Forest turns chaotic when Sir Steel uses his monkey suit to beat Rammy.
After Kai saves some baby turtles, they form a 'Fan Club'
Rammy wants to win the city marathon but he just cannot keep up with Sir Steel's super sneakers.
Sir Steel uses the Professor's invention to get Deer Squad's Powers in 'Switcheroo'
Rammy must learn to trust his friends when he takes care of an abandoned egg.
Sir Steel wants to go to the moon in 'Steel in Space'
A magician steals the audience from Rammy's martial arts performance, and Rammy triggers a rabbit invasion.
Sir Steel and Professor Scratch create doubles of Deer Squad in 'Double Trouble'
It's Recycling Day and Sir Steel puts the whole town in cardboard boxes.
Sir Steel is upset with Lola's art in 'Sky Art'
The Deer Squad race to see whose cart is the fastest, but Sir Steel unexpectedly joins in with his Steelmobile.
Sir Steel talks to the animals in 'Doctor Steel Little'
Sir Steel creates super seeds that grow into gigantic mazes to win the Platinum City Flower Show.
Steel's automated delivery drones create chaos in the city and forest.
When Sir Steel's Slime Machine starts shooting
Whilst some of the Deer Squad down with flu, Sir Steel tries to become a superhero with disastrous results.
Sir Steel gets professor Scratch to create an anti-gravity ray, which goes wrong in the hands of Ricardo.
Muffin's super bouncy ball threatens to wreck the annual Winter Festival. Kai learns to sacrifice something he loves for the greater good.
Lola looks to put up a show at the park in her flying car, but Sir Steel, who is in a high-tech jet, aims to steal the limelight.
When Sir Steel's dog's ball goes missing in the sewers, Bobbi must face his fear of the dark.
Sir Steel wants to shrink the trees in the Central Forest to make way for his new tower; the Deer Squad makes a plan to stop him.
Lola and her souped-up Rocket Rabbit wake the Central Forest residents with the engine's roars.
Sir Steel dons fake antlers to join the Deer Squad as members plan a surprise birthday party for Tina Turtle.
Sir Steel is furious when berries stain his new coat, and Deer Squad must stop him from destroying the berry bushes.
Sir Steel nearly crushes Platinum City with a giant turnip during a Vegetable Show.
When Sir Steel collects metal in the city for Muffin's pooch pamper parlor using a giant magnet, Deer Squad members must think out of the box to stop him.
The city's residents break out in spots thanks to Sir Steel's new face cream.
Sir Steel performs a circus to impress Lady Fluffpot, while Kai charges his battery on the space shuttle. But things get out of control when she gets launched into space by accident.
